messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:

watch waits in night
you see two deactivated android doubles in vault
servers hum in vault
two serve as board ceo
no one but duo opens stash of old war techs
power duo now ask duo to speak
duo speak old war trust no one
carry techs run waste do not speak
